# govault_parameter (Data Source)

Read one GoVault parameter by name, optionally at a specific version. Parameters are for **non-secret configuration** only. Their values are NOT sensitive: they appear in plan output and are stored in clear in Terraform state. Use the `govault_secret` ephemeral resource for secrets. Managing parameters from Terraform is not offered; this provider reads them only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Parameters are non-secret configuration. The value is stored in clear in
# Terraform state. Use the govault_secret ephemeral resource for secrets.
data "govault_parameter" "log_level" {
  name = "app/log-level"
  # version = 2 # optional; omit for the current version
}

output "log_level" {
  value = data.govault_parameter.log_level.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Slash-delimited parameter name in the namespace of the provider session.

### Optional

- `version` (Number) Optional positive version to read; omit for the current version. Always set to the version that was read.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 UTC time this version was created.
- `created_by` (String) Identity that wrote this version; empty when not recorded.
- `description` (String) Description of this version; empty when none was written.
- `revision` (String) Opaque revision identifier of this version.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 UTC time this version was last updated.
- `value` (String) Parameter value. Not sensitive: it is stored in clear in Terraform state.
